2/76 The device shown is a part of an automobile seatback-release mechanism. The
part is subjected to the 4-N force exerted at A and a 300-N · mm restoring moment
exerted by a hidden torsional spring. Determine the y-intercept of the line of action of
the single equivalent force.


 Given F = 4 N,
 M = 300 N-mm
 Θ = 150
 X1 = 10 mm, Y1 = 40 mm
 To find : Y-intercept
 Solution
 Mo = M + FsinθX1 - FcosθY1
  - FcosθxY = 300 + 4xsin15x10 – 4xcos15x40
 Y = (300 + 10.35 – 154.55) / (- 4xcos15)
 Y = 155.8 / - 3.86 = - 40.36 mm
                              S V Venkatesh - Engineering Mechanics – Unit 2 – Chapter – 2 – Force system
